elements.description:
A tool as its API reference entry: the name as the title, the signature and description, a doc table of the
parameters edited in place, an example call, the JSON Schema on request, a validation strip and the approval a
call needs.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The definition. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: approvals
properties.default: [ { id: "inherit", label: "Follows tool permissions", description: "Each agent's access is set where tool permissions are managed" }, { id: "ask", label: "Ask every time", description: "A person approves each call before it runs" }, { id: "auto", label: "Runs on its own", description: "For tools that only read – lookups and searches" }, ]
properties.description: The approvals offered in the head's picker; empty hides it

properties.name: types
properties.default: [ { id: "string", label: "Text" }, { id: "number", label: "Number" }, { id: "integer", label: "Integer" }, { id: "boolean", label: "Yes / no" }, { id: "array", label: "List" }, { id: "object", label: "Object" }, ]
properties.description: The parameter types offered, with their labels

properties.name: example
properties.description: The arguments Example call shows; unset, they're made from the parameters (toolExampleCall)

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The title while the tool has no name; the tool's name replaces it

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quieter line under the title

properties.name: name
properties.description: Submitted with the form: the definition as JSON

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Turns every control off and leaves the definition out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

properties.name: issues
properties.description: What's wrong or missing, as the strip lists it

properties.name: schema
properties.description: The JSON Schema the parameters produce

properties.name: exampleCall
properties.description: The arguments Example call shows: `example`, or ones made from the parameters

properties.name: signature
properties.description: The tool as the model sees it: name(param: type, optional?: type)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: The definition changed ({ value: ToolConfigurationValue }); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

functions.name: toolInputSchema
functions.description: The JSON Schema for a tool's input: an object with one property per parameter

functions.name: toolExampleCall
functions.description: Arguments a call could carry: the first allowed value, else a placeholder of the right type ("<name>", 1, 1.5, true, [], {})

functions.name: validateTool
functions.description: What's wrong with a definition (errors) and what would make it better (warnings)

props.name: title
props.description: The title while the tool has no name – the tool's name replaces it

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The definition to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole definition after every change
